findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "world" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: calculate_fr_labor_exit, check_de_einvoicing · Private data: calculate_jp_penalty_tax, calculate_us_irs_penalty, get_cn_tax_calendar, calculate_cn_business_income_tax, calculate_cn_comprehensive_income_tax, calculate_cn_small_profit_cit, check_cn_small_scale_vat, calculate_cn_late_payment_surcharge, calculate_cn_tax_appeal_deadlines, calculate_cn_depreciation, check_uk_company_calendar, calculate_jp_invoice_transition · Public sink: calculate_fr_labor_exit, calculate_jp_invoice_transition.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: calculate_fr_labor_exit, check_de_einvoicing · Private data: calculate_jp_penalty_tax, calculate_us_irs_penalty, get_cn_tax_calendar, calculate_cn_business_income_tax, calculate_cn_comprehensive_income_tax, calculate_cn_small_profit_cit, check_cn_small_scale_vat, calculate_cn_late_payment_surcharge, calculate_cn_tax_appeal_deadlines, calculate_cn_depreciation, check_uk_company_calendar, calculate_jp_invoice_transition · Public sink: calculate_fr_labor_exit, calculate_jp_invoice_transition

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
